cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Will you keep Mum in the kitchen while I hide her birthday cake? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you stop telling her I'm the one who plans these things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. This one's mine. Could you ask her to show you her pastry trick?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll make me bake a whole pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll peel the apples tonight. Could you get us twenty minutes and a pie?

mechanism: A recruits a secret-plan helper by projecting command while absorbing objections and work to preserve the cooperation the plan depends on.
confusable: Distinguish ordinary delegation from modifying the covert job to keep a reluctant accomplice willing without abandoning apparent leadership.
comparison: Family cake concealment trades credit and pie labor; workplace surprise trades cleanup and spreadsheet work for distraction.
seedUse: Use canonical birthday/leaving-party seeds and their real objections; S02 leadership should be expressed through adapted assignments, not stock voluntary/charge lines.
